content: The M5-4 fitting has a washer that likes to escape when removing the fitting. Make sure it doesn't fall off.

replies.content: Dude! I found that washer a couple of months ago, after doing some work on the Nextruder, but couldn’t figure out where it came from. Thankfully, I kept it. Your comment helped the washer return to its home. Thank you. That was bugging me so much.
